title: attome-changeset/v1
description: One closed metadata changeset: an ordered list of typed operations recorded through the admin API (Solution 7, D-785). File name NNNN-<name>.json inside changesets/platform/ or changesets/<layer>/<scope>/. checksum = "sha256:" + hex sha256 of the canonical JSON (object keys sorted at every depth, no whitespace, arrays in order) of the whole object without the checksum member. Phase 2 operations (stage 2) carry typed args (document_v2/docs/general/SOLUTION-7-PHASE-2-DESIGN.md §3); rules a schema cannot state (the reserved customer choice namespace cust_*, no platform rename, names after a rename, defined conversions) are checked by scripts/changesets/validate.mjs and the server planner. Generated by scripts/changesets/gen-schema.mjs from the catalogue in scripts/changesets/lib.mjs; do not edit by hand.

id.description: UUIDv7 assigned when the changeset was opened; stable across renumbering.

scope.description: "platform" for the platform layer; the product key (e.g. "crm") or customer key (e.g. "acme") otherwise.

seq.description: The NNNN of the file name; contiguous from 1 per folder.

summary.description: Optional generated plain-language summary (decision 0.8). Covered by the checksum when present.

platform.description: Lowest platform release whose binary can apply this changeset (expand -> deploy -> contract order).

after.description: Changesets in other folders (or earlier in this one) that must be applied first.

modules.description: Module keys that must be switched on for this changeset to apply (D-778 Module Management).

target.description: Which object, by logical name or business key.

key.description: Business key: field logical name -> value. Never a database UUID.

op_rename_field.description: rename_field (stage 2: a Phase 2 operation (D-787); a binary without Phase 2 refuses it as op_not_supported)

new_name.description: The new logical (and physical column) name. A name a deleted field once had may be reused (D-788).

op_change_field_type.description: change_field_type (stage 2: a Phase 2 operation (D-787); a binary without Phase 2 refuses it as op_not_supported)

field_type.description: The new type. The field keeps its name, id, labels and references; values that do not convert become empty and are kept 30 days in the recovery archive (D-788).

from_type.description: The type of the source field when the changeset was recorded; the plan blocks when the target deployment disagrees.

true_values.description: text -> bool only; compared case-insensitively after trimming.

map.description: text -> choice only: source text -> choice value; other texts must already be choice values or are reported.

op_add_choice_value.description: add_choice_value (stage 2: a Phase 2 operation (D-787); a binary without Phase 2 refuses it as op_not_supported)

value.description: The stored value. Re-adding a removed value (any label) is allowed (D-788). A customer changeset adds only cust_* values; every other layer never does.

label.description: Display name in the deployment base language (written as the choice_option label unless it equals the value).

after.description: Place after this value; absent or null = at the end.

op_remove_choice_value.description: remove_choice_value (stage 2: a Phase 2 operation (D-787); a binary without Phase 2 refuses it as op_not_supported)

value.description: Removed from the field's choices; records that hold it keep it and show it empty (no data step). Remapping them is a separate map_values data step.

op_set_view_columns.description: set_view_columns (stage 2: a Phase 2 operation (D-787); a binary without Phase 2 refuses it as op_not_supported)

columns.description: The whole column list (view.table_definition), in order.

op_data_step.description: data_step (stage 2: a Phase 2 operation (D-787); a binary without Phase 2 refuses it as op_not_supported)

only_empty.description: copy/convert: write only rows whose target is empty (default true). set_default: always true.

true_values.description: text -> bool only; compared case-insensitively after trimming.

map.description: text -> choice only: source text -> choice value; other texts must already be choice values or are reported.

from_type.description: The type of the source field when the changeset was recorded; the plan blocks when the target deployment disagrees.

on_unmapped.description: map_values: a value not in map is kept (default) or kept and reported.

value.description: set_default: the value written into empty rows.

op_delete_field.description: delete_field (stage 2: a Phase 2 operation (D-787); a binary without Phase 2 refuses it as op_not_supported)
